propositions: The voter-errors alarm fired 5 times in 2 days on transient self-healing events that required no operator intervention and resolved automatically via designed recovery paths.
The current alarm (threshold 0, evaluation_periods 1, Sum>0) pages on any single error marker in a 5-minute window, generating false alarms from isolated transients.

A sustained voter failure (expired token, LLM outage, or Gerrit down) produces continuous error markers across multiple consecutive 5-minute periods and must alarm loudly while isolated transients must not.

The alarm must be recalibrated to 3-of-5 datapoints (3 breaching periods out of 5 consecutive, each 300s) to achieve ~15-minute sustained-failure detection while remaining immune to boundary-straddling transients that clear within 1-2 periods.
